szenen.text: Nine events can move crypto this week. Monday: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks. Any hint on a December hike moves everything.
Tuesday: October retail sales at 8:30 Eastern. Strong spending means more pressure for higher rates. After the close, Nvidia reports, the first time without Jensen Huang.
When tech moves, crypto usually follows. Part two: the rest of the week. Follow.
